Standard: The air vehicle has sufficient pitch control to prevent overrotation (tail strike and stall) with handling qualities no worse than Level 2 during all types of takeoff as specified in MIL- STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power for Takeoff paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the pitch control required during a takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power for Takeoff paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the pitch control required during a takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power for Takeoff paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the pitch control required during a takeoff as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Longitudinal Control Power for Takeoff paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, runway conditions, and environmental conditions.
